name: The Punctuality Trap
description: A goal-conflict story. The AI defaults to punctuality — and every time you let it run, another connection breaks and more passengers are stranded. Feels great early; the bill arrives later. Try protecting connections instead and watch the trade-off.

event.text: Connection at risk: RE5 → RB6 (est. ~70 passengers waiting)

situation.description: RE5 approaches Center. Holding for the RB6 connection costs a few minutes; letting RE5 run keeps it punctual but breaks the connection for an estimated ~70 passengers.
situation.main_conflict: Punctuality vs. the RE5 → RB6 connection
